title: merge: report errors inside the merge API routines.
description:
Don't leave it to the callers of that API to report errors.

While we're at it, use cmdarg_err routines in mergecap.

@guyharris 

It seems I cannot compile on Linux Mint after this MR. The error being

```
[1957/2796] Building C object wiretap/CMakeFiles/wiretap.dir/merge.c.o
FAILED: wiretap/CMakeFiles/wiretap.dir/merge.c.o 
/usr/bin/cc -DENABLE_ASSERT -DG_DISABLE_DEPRECATED -DG_DISABLE_SINGLE_INCLUDES -DWS_BUILD_DLL -DWS_DEBUG -Dwiretap_EXPORTS -I. -I/home/eugene/wireshark -I/home/eugene/wireshark/include -I/home/eugene/wireshark/wiretap -Iwiretap -isystem /usr/include/glib-2.0 -isystem /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/glib-2.0/include -fvisibility=hidden  -Wall -Wextra -Wpointer-arith -Wformat-security -fno-strict-overflow -fexcess-precision=fast -Wvla -Wattributes -Wpragmas -Wredundant-decls -Wunreachable-code -Wlogical-op -Wno-error=stringop-overflow= -Wno-error=deprecated-declarations -Wframe-larger-than=32768 -Wno-format-truncation -fdiagnostics-color=always -Wshadow -Wold-style-definition -Wstrict-prototypes -Wno-pointer-sign  -fmacro-prefix-map="/home/eugene/wireshark/"= -fmacro-prefix-map="/home/eugene/wireshark-ninja/"= -O2 -g -DNDEBUG -fPIC   -std=gnu11 -Werror -MD -MT wiretap/CMakeFiles/wiretap.dir/merge.c.o -MF wiretap/CMakeFiles/wiretap.dir/merge.c.o.d -o wiretap/CMakeFiles/wiretap.dir/merge.c.o   -c /home/eugene/wireshark/wiretap/merge.c
/home/eugene/wireshark/wiretap/merge.c: In function ‘merge_files_common’:
/home/eugene/wireshark/wiretap/merge.c:1264:25: error: ‘err_fileno’ may be used uninitialized in this function [-Werror=maybe-uninitialized]
 1264 |     unsigned            err_fileno;
      |                         ^~~~~~~~~~
cc1: all warnings being treated as errors
[1962/2796] Building CXX object ui/qt/CMakeFiles/qtui.dir/qtui_autogen/mocs_compilation.cpp.o
ninja: build stopped: subcommand failed.
```

I guess the compiler is worried that the routine might be called with no open files; there's a `ws_assert()` that checks for that, but if the compile is being done with `NDEBUG` defined, that assert doesn't do anything.

What compiler and version is this?

!16241 does a workaround that initializes some more variables.

This is my version:

commits_data.title: merge: report errors inside the merge API routines.
commits_data.message:
merge: report errors inside the merge API routines.

Don't leave it to the callers of that API to report errors.

While we're at it, use cmdarg_err routines in mergecap.
